issues.claim: Документация описывает `Add` двумя случаями: если `Count` меньше `Capacity`, это O(1), а если ёмкость нужно увеличить, вызов становится O(n)
issues.problem: The fetched excerpt of the List<T>.Add page is truncated before the Remarks, so it does not show this wording. It matches the Add Remarks section as I know it (O(1) when Count < Capacity, O(n) with n = Count when the capacity must grow), so I treat it as correct. The excerpt for Capacity does not show the growth factor, which the text correctly labels as an implementation detail of .NET 10.
issues.suggestedFix: No change needed. The owner may re-open the Add page and confirm the Remarks wording when setting meta.verified.
